items.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
items.description: The trust framework underlying Belgium's electronic ID system was fully compromised by severe vulnerabilities in a key browser extension, showcasing bigger problems with extensions in general.

items.title: Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
items.description: Threat actors have begun to exploit a newly disclosed Microsoft SharePoint vulnerability following the release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) code. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-55040 (CVSS score: 9.1), which refers to a critical security feature bypass that stems from weak authentication. items.title: Critical WordPress RCE Vulnerability Allows Authors to Execute Code via Malicious PNG File
